categories.main_business_segments: JSP Corporation operates two main business segments: the Extrusion Business and the Beads Business. The Extrusion Business focuses on manufacturing and selling functional and economical plastic products such as expanded polystyrene sheets and boards, polyethylene sheets, and related processed goods. The Beads Business centers on the production and sale of expanded polyolefin beads (ARPRO) and expanded polystyrene beads, serving a variety of applications including automotive, construction, and packaging.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: JSP's core technologies are based on advanced plastic foaming and polymerization techniques. The company leverages extrusion foaming for sheets and boards, and suspension polymerization and bead foaming for bead products. R&D emphasizes lightweight, high-rigidity, heat-resistant, and recyclable materials, with ongoing development in high-performance, environmentally friendly, and bio-based plastics. Manufacturing is supported by global production facilities and proprietary know-how, protected by a robust patent portfolio.
categories.primary_customers_markets: JSP serves a diverse customer base across industries such as automotive (for lightweight parts and impact-absorbing components), construction (insulation and civil engineering materials), electronics (protective packaging for flat panel displays), and food packaging (trays and containers). Major end markets include automotive OEMs and suppliers, building and construction firms, electronics manufacturers, and packaging companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: JSP operates globally with significant presence in Japan, North America (notably the US and Mexico), Europe (including France, Germany, and the Czech Republic), Asia (China, Taiwan, Korea, Singapore, India), and South America (Brazil). The company maintains manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in 11 countries and serves customers worldwide, with a strategic focus on expanding in overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: JSP is positioned as a midstream manufacturer, transforming petrochemical raw materials into high-value-added foamed plastics and semi-finished or finished products. Its products are supplied to downstream industries such as automotive, construction, electronics, and packaging, often as intermediate materials or components integrated into customers' final products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, JSP prioritizes strengthening and expanding its core businesses, developing high-value-added and environmentally friendly products, and pursuing global market growth. R&D is focused on sustainability themes such as resource efficiency, recycling, carbon neutrality, and bio-based materials. The company is also investing in automation, digital transformation (DX), and new business creation, including M&A, to drive innovation and respond to evolving customer and societal needs.
categories.revenue_model: JSP generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured plastic foam products and materials to industrial customers. Revenue is recognized at the point of delivery or shipment, with some licensing income from technology and know-how provided to overseas subsidiaries and partners. The company also receives royalties from technology licensing agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: JSP competes with global and regional manufacturers of foamed plastics and advanced materials, including companies like Sekisui Chemical, Kaneka, and other international foam producers. The company is recognized as a leading global supplier in the expanded polyolefin bead market (ARPRO) and maintains a strong position in insulation and packaging materials, leveraging its technological expertise and global footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, JSP reported consolidated net sales of 142.3 billion yen, with operating profit of 6.9 billion yen and net income attributable to parent company shareholders of 5.1 billion yen. The company employs over 3,000 people worldwide. JSP has demonstrated steady sales growth in recent years, with a strategic target to reach 160 billion yen in sales and 10 billion yen in operating profit by FY2027, focusing on profitability and capital efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JSP differentiates itself through advanced foaming technologies that deliver lightweight, high-performance, and environmentally conscious materials. Its products offer superior insulation, shock absorption, recyclability, and energy/resource efficiency, addressing customer needs for sustainability and cost-effectiveness. The company emphasizes its ability to provide innovative, customized solutions globally, supported by strong R&D and a commitment to contributing to a circular economy.
